newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -BTPs to target contract high at 131.86.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -BTPs to target contract high at 131.86.

text.p: September BTPs traded on LIFFE look positive on Thursday and may try to re-test the contract high at 131.86, technical analysts said.

"BTPs have broken back up. The market is on the next stage of its upmove and I'm very constructive," said Stavros Loizou, manager strategic trading at Fuji Bank in London. "The last resistance hurdle is 131.90."
The contract formed a high just below that level at 131.86 on May 21.
At 0755 GMT, September BTPs were at 131.18, up 38 basis points on the day.
Loizou said some interim resistance stepped in at 131.68, an old low on hourly charts.
In early trade on Thursday the contract opened at 130.85 and dipped to 130.75 before rallying higher. Loizou said Wednesday's high at 130.90 would now act as initial support.
"Below that there is nothing until 130.52," he said.
Marc Ostwald, technical strategist at London Bond Broking here, also said BTPs had the potential to break up to the contract high.
"I just wonder how much further we can go on the upside," he said.
"Everyone seems to have it on board now and the contract is very volatile at the moment so we may be due another set back today," he said.

Ostwald said to the downside there was some minor support around 130.25, 28, the lows on June 4 and 5 but the first significant support came from a small gap between the June 11 low at 130.08 and June 10 high at 130.07.
"Then we have more solid support in the 129.78, 85 area which were the highs on May 29 and June 2 respectively," he said.
At the short end, September Eurolire futures were at 93.43, up 10 basis points on the day.
